lore: The cash register of a corner shop: heavy oak, an iron rim and a slot that only swallows coins.
use: Place it, set a price and put a Display Case on top. The price row takes up to five exact items; earnings pile up inside, also while you are away.
secret: Left click adds one to a price, right click adds the stack you hold. Only you, or an operator, can ever break it.

lore: A glass lid on a wooden plinth, built to show off the one thing a buyer came for.
use: Stand it on your Sales Block. An item in hand goes into the next free slot; empty hand opens the goods menu with five slots. Buyers take one piece per trade.
secret: Hoppers and golems cannot reach inside, and no explosion will crack the glass.

lore: The same case, with a drop of glow ink in the glass: the goods shine like a shop window at night.
use: Works exactly like the Display Case, and gives off a weak light of its own while it shows goods.
secret: Craft it from a Display Case and a glow ink sac; the goods are drawn fully bright.

lore: A crate with two iron bands and a funnel on top: the overflow bin of a busy shop.
use: Hang it under your Sales Block (or under another storage). It pulls the earnings down by itself, hopper style, as long as every block of the chain is yours. Right click to take things out.
secret: Strangers cannot open, break, push or empty it; hoppers do not see it. A full chain turns the Trade button off.
